channel.title: Nicotine Science and Policy
channel.description: Daily digest of views, debates and discussions on nicotine science, policy, regulation and advocacy.

item.title: Ireland Is Banning Vape Flavors. This Shop Owner Warns It Could Cost Lives.
item.description: Ireland's planned restrictions on vape flavours are raising concerns among independent retailers and former smokers who rely on non-tobacco flavours to stay away from cigarettes. (Published on October 29, 2026byreason.com)

item.title: No Clear Rules | Mi-Pod’s Finance Chief on Uncertainty Facing U.S. Vaping | RegWatch
item.description: Unclear federal regulations and conflicting state restrictions are creating significant challenges for US vaping businesses, affecting compliance, financial planning and long-term stability. (Published on October 29, 2026byregulatorwatch.com)

item.title: When Listening Becomes Another Way to Lecture
item.description: Interviews with 20 illicit tobacco users in New Zealand reveal how financial hardship, nicotine dependence and frustration with tobacco policies influence purchasing decisions. (Published on October 29, 2026bysubstack.com)

item.title: Cigarettes are losing importance. Data show a clear shift among young people
item.description: Norway's latest figures reveal a significant generational shift in nicotine use. Daily smoking has fallen to just 6% of the population, while 15% now use snus, making it more than twice as common as cigarettes. (Published on October 29, 2026bymojanorwegia.pl)
